title: Reproducing Wang, Hu and Irene 1994: thermal oxidation of germanium at 400 to 550 °C

sample.ours: FAMILY: Ge_GeO2; ORIENTATION: Ge100; DOPING: n_type; RESISTIVITY_OHM_CM: 20 (recorded; no program reads them)

sample.note: The vocabulary of cleans has no germanium clean.

sample.paper: not stated. Figure 1a starts at about 0 nm, Figure 1b at about 1 nm
sample.ours: a fitted starting thickness inside the program, a function of the oxidation temperature
sample.note: A property of the sample held as a fitted parameter of the program; the history cannot state it and the alignment cannot vary it.

sample.paper: “there is always a distinct interface layer” of GeO2 and amorphous Ge, 1.4 to 4.8 nm (Table 1)
sample.ours: not in our sample or programs; the dataset holds the total

sample.paper: ECR plasma oxidation of the same wafers at 100 to 400 °C
sample.ours: not encoded: no ambient or program for a plasma

history.item: Bromine-methanol etch, buffered HF, water rinse
history.paper: “0.05-vol% bromine in methanol etching, followed by a buffered HF cleaning step, and a final deionized water rinsing” (after Aspnes)
history.ours: CLEAN: not_stated: the vocabulary's cleans are silicon cleans
history.note: The surface it leaves is not described; time in air before loading is not stated.

history.paper: “After a cleaned Ge substrate was loaded in the vacuum chamber, the substrate temperature was raised in vacuum.”
history.ours: recorded; the heat-up follows as a RUN in vacuum

history.paper: “the substrate temperature was raised in vacuum. When the substrate reached the desired temperature, the high vacuum valve between processing chamber and the turbomolecular pump was closed.”
history.ours: RUN HeatUp DURATION 300 TEMP 25->400 AMBIENT vacuum
history.note: Lamp-heated holder; five minutes is ours. The growth program does not read the gas, so it grows oxide here as if in oxygen (a few hundredths of a nanometre).

history.item: Pump valved off; real-time ellipsometry started
history.paper: “Real-time SWE commenced and then oxygen was admitted into the processing chamber.”
history.ours: recorded; time zero of the figures is the next step

history.item: Oxygen admitted, chamber filling toward 1 atm
history.paper: “Oxygen flow rate was 150 sccm.” The chamber was valved off from the pump; its volume and the time to reach 1 atm are not stated
history.ours: RUN Fill DURATION 30 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT mix:O2=0.5
history.note: Written as half an atmosphere of oxygen, the mean of a linear fill, for 30 s. Ours: the language cannot write a pressure that rises within a step, and the growth program does not read the pressure. Our curve's clock starts after this step, the paper's at its start.

history.paper: “Thermal oxidations were carried out at 1 atm in pure O2 in the same system, but without microwave plasma operation … Oxygen flow rate was 150 sccm.”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 33360 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Moisture is not stated; the purity is printed as “999.997%”.

history.paper: “Upon completion of an oxidation experiment the system was evacuated”
history.ours: recorded; the cooling follows in vacuum

history.item: Cooled in vacuum to room temperature
history.paper: “and SE was performed after cooling the sample to room temperature”
history.ours: RUN Cool DURATION 1800 TEMP 400->25 AMBIENT vacuum PROFILE exponential TAU 300
history.note: An exponential fall with a 5 min time constant is ours; nothing grows in vacuum physically, but the growth program does not know that.

history.item: Spectroscopic ellipsometry at room temperature, two-layer model
history.paper: “The SE measurements were taken with the samples inside the vacuum chamber … after cooling to room temperature”; two layers: GeO2 over GeO2 + a-Ge
history.ours: the observable Thickness (total of the two layers)
history.note: The dataset holds the total thickness; the interface layer has no program.

history.paper: “The results shown in Figure 1d were obtained from thermal oxidation in a conventional oxidation furnace.” The caption makes 1d the plasma panel
history.ours: all points as one chamber sequence
history.note: If the sentence means Figure 1b, the long-time points were heated in a furnace, probably in oxygen, and measured outside the chamber. Tried as a variant below.

steps.name: Clean
steps.label: Bromine-methanol etch, buffered HF, water rinse
steps.paper: “0.05-vol% bromine in methanol etching, followed by a buffered HF cleaning step, and a final deionized water rinsing” (after Aspnes)
steps.timing: No time given for any part

steps.name: Load
steps.label: Loaded into the vacuum chamber
steps.paper: “After a cleaned Ge substrate was loaded in the vacuum chamber, the substrate temperature was raised in vacuum.”
steps.timing: Pressure at loading not stated (the chamber “can be evacuated to 1x10-7 torr”)

steps.name: HeatUp
steps.label: Heated in vacuum to 400 °C
steps.isl: RUN HeatUp DURATION 300 TEMP 25->400 AMBIENT vacuum
steps.paper: “the substrate temperature was raised in vacuum. When the substrate reached the desired temperature, the high vacuum valve between processing chamber and the turbomolecular pump was closed.”
steps.timing: Ramp rate and any hold in vacuum not stated

steps.name: Valve
steps.label: Pump valved off; real-time ellipsometry started
steps.paper: “Real-time SWE commenced and then oxygen was admitted into the processing chamber.”
steps.timing: Time zero is the admission of oxygen

steps.name: Fill
steps.label: Oxygen admitted, chamber filling toward 1 atm
steps.isl: RUN Fill DURATION 30 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT mix:O2=0.5
steps.paper: “Oxygen flow rate was 150 sccm.” The chamber was valved off from the pump; its volume and the time to reach 1 atm are not stated
steps.timing: Not stated. The real-time curves (Figure 1a) show oxide growing within the first minute, so the fill cannot take long at full effect

steps.name: Oxidation
steps.label: Dry oxidation in 1 atm O2, 400 °C
steps.isl: RUN Oxidation DURATION 33360 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: “Thermal oxidations were carried out at 1 atm in pure O2 in the same system, but without microwave plasma operation … Oxygen flow rate was 150 sccm.”
steps.timing: Times appear only on the axis of Figure 1b and in Tables 1 and 3; whether each point is a separate sample, and whether the long times were in a “conventional oxidation furnace” (PDF p. 8), is not stated

steps.name: Evacuate
steps.label: Chamber evacuated
steps.paper: “Upon completion of an oxidation experiment the system was evacuated”
steps.timing: Not timed

steps.name: Cool
steps.label: Cooled in vacuum to room temperature
steps.isl: RUN Cool DURATION 1800 TEMP 400->25 AMBIENT vacuum PROFILE exponential TAU 300
steps.paper: “and SE was performed after cooling the sample to room temperature”
steps.timing: Cooling rate and time not stated

steps.label: Spectroscopic ellipsometry at room temperature, two-layer model
steps.paper: “The SE measurements were taken with the samples inside the vacuum chamber … after cooling to room temperature”; two layers: GeO2 over GeO2 + a-Ge
